# QuantBuddy 自动生成 · 均线金叉 + RSI
def handle_data(ctx, data):
  ma5 = data.hist('hs300', 5).mean()
  ma20 = data.hist('hs300', 20).mean()
  rsi = RSI(data.hist('hs300', 14))
  if ma5 > ma20 and rsi < 70:
    order_target_pct('hs300', 1.0)
  elif ma5 < ma20:
    order_target_pct('hs300', 0)
